goal: Recover the official FlagEmbedding BGE-M3 teacher-score training path for a standalone hybrid-aware Arabic student by isolating the v41/v60 SIGSEGV blocker.

research_basis.implication: BGE-M3 is designed around dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval, so the next standalone student should preserve the official M3 retrieval surface.
The official FlagEmbedding finetuning path supports teacher-score distillation data with query, pos, neg, pos_scores, and neg_scores fields.
The official M3 training implementation exposes unified dense/sparse/ColBERT losses and head-only training via fix_encoder.

teacher_data.teacher: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 over MIRACL Arabic train rows from BGE-M3 hybrid r100 candidates

probes.name: v60-overlay-torchrun-unified
probes.failure: SIGSEGV before completing the first training step under torchrun/DDP.

probes.name: v60b-overlay-torchrun-dense
probes.failure: SIGSEGV in torch.nn.parallel.DistributedDataParallel parameter-shape verification via Accelerate prepare_model.

interpretation: The official FlagEmbedding M3 trainer is not inherently blocked on this remote GPU.
The v41/v60 blocker is the torchrun/DDP path on the current L20 binary stack; faulthandler places the crash in DDP parameter-shape verification, before model-quality evidence is produced.
A single-process wrapper that only patches uninitialized torch.distributed get_rank/get_world_size is sufficient to run both dense KD and unified dense+sparse+ColBERT head-only KD for one step.
This is an engineering unblock, not a model improvement. No v60 checkpoint should be uploaded or claimed.

decision.next_experiment: Run a gated official FlagEmbedding M3 no-DDP head-only smoke using the v50 teacher rows and the existing v52-v54 same-candidate diagnostic. It must beat the frozen BGE-M3 hybrid base by at least +0.005 nDCG@10 before any larger standalone-student training.
